children: Sweden fashion retailer's Q3 net sales rose 1% in local currencies, slightly beating estimates
Q3 operating profit rose and beat analyst expectations, helped by one-time tariff effects
Company cites cost control and operational efficiency as drivers of improved profitability
H&M expects September 2026 sales to rise 1% in local currencies versus prior year
Company says it is well placed to meet customer needs despite ongoing logistics disruptions
COST CONTROL AND EFFICIENCY - Co said improved purchasing, cost control and more efficient operations drove profitability gains
ONE-TIME TARIFF EFFECTS - Qtr margins benefited from one-time effects related to tariffs and goods imports
SUMMER COLLECTIONS - Co said summer collections were well received and contributed to better sales development towards end of qtr
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
